generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional tender will not be considered
Tender application amount will not be refundable
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason
The contractor has to compete the bid (quote the rates) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & tender transaction fee in the Kppp portal using any of the following payment modes Credit Card, Direct Debit,OTC, National Electronic Fund transfer NEFT along with online EMD & E bank guarantee

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the Kppp portal. the original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verification otherwise the tenders will be treated as Nonresponsive & liable for rejection
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labour welfare fund
The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. there is no departmental supply of materials

All documents enclosed should be attested by Gazetted officer or Government Notary,otherwise the bids are liable for disqualifcation.Original documents should be produced for verifcation at any stage of the tender process, as and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualifcation. work done certificates should have all the CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year
The tenderer shall have valid Class 3 & Above Registration Certifcate
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment
Royalty charges will be deducted from the contractors running bill as per the prevailing royalty charges at the time of payment.
The tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-3 and shall abide for the conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW-3

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without there by incurring any liability to the affected tenderer or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action
IT & GST will be deducted as per government order

Contractors have to upload the Certificates of works in hand of any Department/Institutions failing which the tender will not be considered. Action will be taken as per clause 31 of SECTION 2: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS (ITT) in case of incomplete/ false documents regarding works in hand for the calculation of tender capacity

If mineral dispatch permits not submitted by contractors for usage of respective minerals for construction the royalty charges with penalty will be deducted from the contractors running bill as per the direction given by concern department or government at the time of payment
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No.FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru dated:25-08-2020

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and murrum etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No.Ga.Bhu.E/DCB/DCB/takte/2019- 20/4497 Dated :12/12/2019 by Mines and Geology department
Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately as per Bid document
All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent
Annual turnover certificate along with Balance sheet certified/attested by Chartered Accountants should be uploaded with 18-Digits system generated unique number (UDIN Number)

Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement should be submitted in the prescribed format as per the state government circular No. GO-FD-CAM/16/2022(P-2)/,Banglore-dt 22-08-2022. If not submitted in the prescribed format tenders will be liable for rejection
Action will be taken as per AS PER KW-3 CONDITION 3.7 for The contractor those who have not comlpeted work in time in this division.

The contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST for either materials or works contract(service).GST payable by the contractor under this works contract will be paid to the contractor over and above the contractors bid amount

The tenderer has to quote his rate by excluding GST. However contract will be concluded for the AMOUNT (Exclusive of GST) but applicable GST will be paid separately as per GST prevailing at the time of execution. If the GST rates are revised during the contract period, the Tenderer/ Employer has to accept the revised GST rates for making payment/recovery
Royalty deductions shall be as per order No.C1-MMN/202/2023 DTD 25-01-2025.
Regardin GST, Royalty, MDP and other deductions will be done as per the prevailing orders
Prevailing Ammemdments and notification are applicable
Post tender process shall be done in contract management module as per GO.no. DPAR 154EGV DATED-23-7-2024
